rationale: The prompt requires Assess a proposed change against a supplied set of requirements. Read the requirements before examining the change and its automated checks. When they are usable, keep their original sequence and give one result per requirement: f; the anchored # judge-spec-compliance explicitly scopes the source-visible workflow to "Use when a diff needs a requirement review — does it satisfy every stated acceptance criterion — dispatched by /review-changes, /do-and-judge, /judge. Never infers criteria from the diff.". That scope directly supports the requested input, transformation, and deliverable rather than leaving a material component unaddressed.
